node.title: Migración y capitalización de capacidad
node.summary: Capability creation, carriers, operation and value capture can occur in different places.

relations: The corridor invites a bounded attribution study of where a capability is created, maintained and capitalized, rather than inferring its value from the location that books the revenue.
La generalización transfronteriza es una hipótesis; el desempeño macro de Chicontepec no prueba extracción ni pérdida de cada capacidad local.
A cross-border follow-up should establish whether the same capability was retained, transferred, duplicated or lost before applying an attribution-gap explanation.
El protocolo empresarial requiere adaptación a dos entidades; no se pueden normalizar sus presupuestos como una única cuota de crédito.
The survivor lens sharpens value discovery: identify the useful capability and its carriers before deciding which legacy form should remain, change or disappear.
Encontrar valor en un legado no legitima conservar todo su coste, riesgo o estructura de atribución.
